data.description:
## Incident Overview

CI Hook Tests fail with 7 failures across 5 test files after dso.workflow migration (sprint epic 3b8b).

## Root Causes

1. tests/hooks/test-mode-detect.sh: Old test file uses legacy enforcement.strategy+merge.strategy+git-remote detection; mode-detect.sh now reads dso.workflow only
2. tests/hooks/test-post-agent-attribution.sh + test-post-skill-attribution.sh: Mocks return 'true' for attribution.enabled; post-functions.sh now reads dso.workflow, checks for 'ci-pr'
3. tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh: Configs use enforcement.strategy=ci; enforcement-gate.sh reads dso.workflow. With only enforcement.strategy=ci (no merge.strategy=pr) the shim returns 'local' not 'ci-pr'. Also expected message string is outdated.
4. tests/hooks/test-fix-bug-worktree-integration.sh: 007d cleanup removed isolation_enabled references from fix-bug SKILL.md; test checks for both isolation branches

## PR Comments to Address (PR #135)
- merge-to-main-direct.sh:616 DSO_WORKFLOW never exported by dispatcher (dead code path)
- apply-attribution-trailers.sh: empty _resolve_read_config_script path causes bash '' failure
- read-config.sh: legacy fallback missing trailing newline
- github-bootstrap.sh: no explicit config path to read-config.sh
- dso-config.reference.conf: wrong attribution comment
- CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md: worktree.isolation_enabled description stale
- debug-everything/SKILL.md: MERGE_STRATEGY=pr vs ci-pr mismatch
- onboarding/SKILL.md: duplicate dso.workflow key risk
- per-worktree-review-commit.md: invalid config-read command
- docs/adr/0014: broken script path ref and missing code fence language
- INSTALL.md: missing blank lines around fenced block
data.title: [Hook Tests CI]: dso.workflow S5/S6 migration left legacy-key refs in 5 test files -> 7 test failures
